name: V_EHI_REG_ITEM_AUDIT_FNC
description: Financial assistance case audit events.This view contains audit information for financial assistance case records for the purpose of Electronic Health Information (EHI) export. If not in the EHI context, REG_ITEM_AUDIT_FNC and REG_ITEM_AUDIT_LINES_FNC should be used instead.

columns.name: ITEM_AUDIT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the audit event record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: AUDIT_INSTANT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The instant the audit was recorded in the UTC time zone.

columns.name: AUDIT_INSTANT_LOCAL_DTTM
columns.description: The instant the audit was recored in the local time zone where the change took place.

columns.name: FIN_ASST_CASE_ID
columns.description: Financial assistance case that was changed in this audit event.

columns.name: CHANGED_DATA_ELEMENT
columns.description: The name of the Clarity table and column corresponding to the changed data.

columns.name: CHANGED_ITEM_NAME
columns.description: Name of the item that was changed in the audit event.

columns.name: CHANGED_LINE
columns.description: Item line that was changed in the audit event.

columns.name: CHANGED_SUB_LINE
columns.description: Item subline that was changed in the audit event.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE_EXTERNAL
columns.description: External value of the item line before the item was changed.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE_EXTERNAL
columns.description: External value of the item line after the item was changed.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: User who changed the items in this audit event.

columns.name: USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.
